acv.quote: About a hundred and forty K a year.

data.reason: The deal turned when our solutions engineer priced the manual deposit matching from one month of the customer's own statements, and the CFO accepted it as 'that's my number, not yours.' The earlier portal and checkout pitch had stalled, and the rep had the deal at 20 percent.

trigger.action: Aim messaging at new CFOs facing a slow month-end close and hand-matched deposits, not at online portal launches.
trigger.quote: She'd been there about four months, and her first month-end close took nine days.

decider.action: Put the finance problem and its cost on page one of proposals, so a forwarded proposal still speaks to the CFO.
decider.quote: she read the first page and said it wasn't her problem

competitor.action: Prepare reps to answer an incumbent bank's rate offer with deposit visibility and a named contact; ask customers what Fiserv actually showed, since the AE never saw it.
competitor.quote: I didn't ask about my rates.
